text.description_html:
Omnia 9452 Classic Stainless Steel Cabinet Handles

Classic in design this cabinet pull can be mounted either vertical or horizontally. It comes in 3 sizes and 2 finishes. Made of stainless steel by Omnia, you can be sure that it is strong, durable, and will resist corrosion making this lever and excellent choice for high traffic homes with either ultra modern or more traditional decors.

Since this contemporary cabinet pull is so easy to clean it will maintain a smooth, rich luster for the lifetime of your home; and just like all Omnia's stainless steel cabinet handles, the modern styled pull will prove worthy of the exceptional standards that Omnia has sustained for more than 40 years.

Available in 3 Sizes:

  • OMN-9452/20 - Length13/16" (single hole mount), Projection: 1-1/8
  • OMN-9452/89 - Length: 4-5/8", Projection: 1-1/8
  • OMN-9452/152 - Length: 7-1/8", Projection: 1-1/8

Sold Individually
